integrity: Reconstructed complete simplices and verified integral Morse differentials plus independent prime-field boundary ranks; executable standard-library checker embedded.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite homotopy calculations for n=4,5,6 and no torsion for n=1,2,3 within a fixed bidirected K2,n family; does not assert all-parameter coverage, universal minimality, or an independently audited result. Published statements inspected may have later revisions.
title: Two-torsion in unstable bidirected complete-bipartite multipath complexes
